title_as_printed: Experimental Data on Composition of Dew-Point Gas in Ethane-Water System
pressure_note: Pressure held constant within 1 lb/sq in. during gas withdrawal; 'Pressure, Lb./Sq. In. Abs.'; total pressure of heterogeneous (water + ethane gas) system
conversion_needs: F to K; psia to Pa
notes: Three side-by-side column blocks in print (100/160/220 F left; 280/340 F middle; 400/460 F right) stacked in temperature order 100..460 F. Row order within each block as printed (not sorted by pressure). Dew-point gas phase in equilibrium with aqueous liquid. Standard conditions for gas volumes not applicable.
quality_remarks: Suspected misprint in the original, cell kept: 220 F, 536.6 psia, y_H2O x10^3 = 3.362. Water vapour pressure at 220 F is about 17.2 psia, so y is about 0.032 at that pressure; the printed value is about a factor 10 too low and probably should read 33.62 (compare 160 F, 320.8 psia: 15.57 against Psat/P = 14.8). Rows at 400 F are printed in non-monotonic pressure order.
